name: Legden (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Legden (yellow stars on blue beneath a yellow chief, above red and white lozenges).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Münster of 5 March 1970 the municipality of Legden was granted the right to bear arms and a flag, described as a flag with the municipal arms and the colours blue and silver (white).

features.role: Legden arms — stars, chief and lozenges
